presets.name: CRT Geom
presets.description: Classic curved CRT with scanlines, an aperture-grille mask and rounded corners.

presets.name: CRT Lottes
presets.description: Timothy Lottes' CRT with soft scanlines, a shadow mask, bloom and slight curvature.

presets.name: CRT Pi
presets.description: Lightweight flat CRT with scanlines and a subtle mask. Fast on any GPU.

presets.name: zfast CRT
presets.description: Very fast CRT scanlines with a fine mask.

presets.name: CRT Guest Advanced
presets.description: Detailed CRT simulation with phosphor afterglow, bloom, halation and masks. The most demanding preset in this list; its first compile takes a few seconds.

presets.name: SMAA
presets.description: Subpixel morphological anti-aliasing that smooths remaining jagged edges.

presets.name: AMD FSR 1.0
presets.description: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0. Sharpens the internal image; with Native N64 input it upscales the 240-line image to the window.

presets.name: Adaptive Sharpen
presets.description: Contrast-aware sharpening that avoids halos around edges.

presets.name: ScaleFX
presets.description: Pixel-art edge smoothing that rounds diagonal stair steps in the native image.

presets.name: Vivid Colours
presets.description: Richer colours with slightly more contrast, using the public-domain image-adjustment shader.
